description: Worker-facing guidance text values. Not decision thresholds (those live in abudhabi-heat-v1.json). Golden-tested against every card language.

hydration_cup_interval_min.citation: NIOSH 2016-106, Executive Summary and Ch. 7: 'drinking 1 cup [8 oz.] of water or other fluids every 15–20 minutes'; Table 8-1 note: intake should not exceed 1.5 qt per hour.

emergency_number.citation: UAE emergency numbers: 998 ambulance, 999 police. The employer's site emergency plan number must replace the demo value.
